Removed redundant `rdfs:label` annotation assertions for imported annotation properties from `src/ontology/cl-edit.owl`.

Rationale:
- The issue identified labels in the `-edit` file for imported annotation properties that already carry labels from import modules.
- Those local labels are redundant and can create noisy diffs when the generated annotation-property comments change.
- CL should keep only its own annotation-property axioms in the edit file.

What changed:
- Removed pure imported-annotation-property label-only blocks for:
  - `IAO:0000028`
  - `IAO:0000115`
  - `IAO:0000424`
  - `IAO:0000700`
  - `IAO:0100001`
  - `oboInOwl:SubsetProperty`
  - `oboInOwl:SynonymTypeProperty`
  - `oboInOwl:consider`
  - `oboInOwl:hasBroadSynonym`
  - `oboInOwl:hasDbXref`
  - `oboInOwl:hasExactSynonym`
  - `oboInOwl:hasNarrowSynonym`
  - `oboInOwl:hasRelatedSynonym`
  - `oboInOwl:hasSynonymType`
  - `oboInOwl:inSubset`
  - `oboInOwl:shorthand`
- Removed only the redundant `rdfs:label` axioms from imported properties that still have CL-specific axioms in the file:
  - `uberon:HUMAN_PREFERRED`
  - `uberon:LATIN`
  - `uberon:PLURAL`
  - `rdfs:seeAlso`
- Preserved all non-redundant CL-owned annotation property axioms.

Validation performed:
- Confirmed the issue discussion explicitly supported removing these redundant labels.
- Checked the annotation-property block in `cl-edit.owl` to distinguish imported properties from CL-owned properties.
- Ran `robot convert -i src/ontology/cl-edit.owl -o /tmp/opencode/cl-edit.ofn` successfully to verify ontology syntax after the edit.

Checklist completed:
- [x] Read imported issue context
- [x] Inspected affected annotation property axioms in `src/ontology/cl-edit.owl`
- [x] Removed only redundant imported-property labels
- [x] Preserved CL-specific annotation property axioms
- [x] Validated ontology syntax with `robot convert`
- [x] Committed only `src/ontology/cl-edit.owl`
